oracle_write_evidence.finding: Oracle exposes a dedicated PUT /activity endpoint with a List<Activity> request schema. The endpoint documentation includes the remaining fields in the Activity entity schema, but schema presence alone is not treated as proof that every field is writable.
oracle_write_evidence.policy: PUT schema inclusion establishes endpoint-schema exposure only. It does not certify field mutability. Computed/derived fields remain Shared Scheduling/Core authority unless Oracle field-level write semantics and internal mapping evidence justify otherwise.
oracle_write_evidence.schema_exposure_interpretation: The Release 26 PUT endpoint accepts Activity objects and exposes the tranche fields in the Activity schema. This establishes endpoint-schema exposure, not field-level mutability certification.
oracle_write_evidence.next_certification_step: Resolve field-level writable/read-only semantics and canonical mapping from Oracle create/update behavior plus authoritative internal mapping/import/export paths. Do not promote from schema presence alone.

WBSObjectId is explicitly required in the Activity schema; schema exposure still does not certify the internal canonical mapping or field-level persistence semantics.

confirmed_documented_semantics.SecondaryConstraintDate: Constraint date used with the secondary constraint type; activity constraints are used by the project scheduler.
confirmed_documented_semantics.SecondaryConstraintType: Additional scheduler constraint with documented start/finish on-or-before/on-or-after values.
confirmed_documented_semantics.Status: Current activity status values are documented.
confirmed_documented_semantics.StatusCode: Project status values are documented separately from activity status.
confirmed_documented_semantics.SuspendDate: Suspend date is constrained relative to actual start and suspend/resume affects scheduling calendar treatment.
confirmed_documented_semantics.ToCompletePerformanceIndex: TCPI is documented as a computed performance metric.
confirmed_documented_semantics.TotalCost1Variance: Primary-baseline total-cost variance is documented as a computed value.
confirmed_documented_semantics.TotalCost2Variance: Secondary-baseline total-cost variance is documented as a computed value.
confirmed_documented_semantics.TotalCost3Variance: Tertiary-baseline total-cost variance is documented as a computed value.
confirmed_documented_semantics.TotalCostVariance: Project-baseline total-cost variance is documented as a computed value.
confirmed_documented_semantics.ScopePercentComplete: Release 26 Activity schema exposes this as number (double), but the endpoint text supplies no field description; semantic use remains schema-only pending further field-level evidence.
confirmed_documented_semantics.UnitsPercentComplete: The percentage of units for labor and nonlabor resources assigned to the activity; Oracle documents it as computed as actual units / at-completion units * 100.
confirmed_documented_semantics.UnreadCommentCount: The number of Team Member Discussion comments associated with the Activity that have not yet been read.
confirmed_documented_semantics.WBSCode: The short code assigned to each WBS element; Oracle documents parent-code concatenation for WBS identification.
confirmed_documented_semantics.WBSName: The name of the WBS element.
confirmed_documented_semantics.WBSNamePath: The activity's WBS name path is exposed as a string field.
confirmed_documented_semantics.WBSObjectId: The unique ID of the WBS for the activity; ProjectObjectId and WBSObjectId are required in the Activity schema.
confirmed_documented_semantics.WorkPackageId: The Work Package identifier is exposed as a string field.
confirmed_documented_semantics.WorkPackageName: The Work Package name is exposed as a string field.
confirmed_documented_semantics.Type: The Activity Type field is exposed as a string; type-specific scheduling semantics require field-level mapping evidence before canonical implementation.
